QUIC server fuzz test that builds UDP/IPv4 packets and feeds them to packet processing.

# Purpose
This file is a fuzz test harness for the QUIC server code. It builds a `fd_quic_t` server instance, configures it with a local workspace and limits, and then feeds it synthetic network packets through `fd_quic_process_packet`. The harness uses [`LLVMFuzzerInitialize`](<#llvmfuzzerinitialize>) to set up the Firedancer runtime, allocate workspace memory, create the QUIC server, and attach a dummy `fd_aio_t` transmit path. It also sets QUIC configuration values such as `idle_timeout`, `retry`, and `initial_rx_max_stream_data`.

The main test entry point is [`LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput`](<#llvmfuzzertestoneinput>), which reads fuzz input as a sequence of length-prefixed packet payloads. For each payload, [`send_packet`](<#send_packet>) constructs an IPv4/UDP packet in `scratch`, encodes the headers with `fd_quic_encode_ip4` and `fd_quic_encode_udp`, computes the IPv4 checksum, copies the payload, and passes the packet to the QUIC server. The file also defines [`init_quic`](<#init_quic>) and [`destroy_quic`](<#destroy_quic>) helpers for server setup and teardown, and it uses `FD_FUZZ_MUST_BE_COVERED` markers to track fuzz coverage.
